description: Content management for the homepage and the Help Center and Journal copy
acceptance: An editor changes the homepage hero in /admin/cms and the public homepage updates within 60s without redeploy; a Playwright test proves it
evidence: cms_sections and cms_section_versions store bilingual hero, collection and banner sections with status, schedule, order, last-10 versions and a revalidated public homepage (5d3d819); the client list needed a strings-only copy object because the admin dictionary carries a function (a5b492f). Site settings (0387cec) add one versioned site_settings record for the announcement bar, header and footer links, metadata defaults and the bilingual shipping and return text, read once in the root layout and published at /policies; the link schema now accepts a label in one language, since localisedLinks already falls back (c41dab8). Playwright 42057524731 passed 26 checks on the deployment: it renamed the hero in /admin/cms/sections and saw it on / within 60s, switched the announcement on, followed its link to /policies, added and removed a footer link, and checked the CMS routes at 375, 768 and 1440px. Help Center topics (ea2c0c8) add help_categories and help_category_versions with bilingual names, descriptions, a display order and the last ten versions, edited at /admin/cms/help with move-up and move-down forms; cms_entries.help_category_id files a help article under one topic and is excluded from the entry snapshot, so a restore never moves an article. /help takes ?q= and ?category=, searches titles, excerpts and bodies once the phrase reaches two characters and keeps the chosen topic across a search; help_article_votes counts votes with a first-party sd_help_visitor cookie and a unique (entryId, visitorId) row, so a reader can change the answer and one browser cannot vote twice. Playwright 42170834094 passed 35 checks, including the Journal slice: a cover and tags on a post, the tag filter, a restore that brings the cover and tags back, and 375, 768 and 1440 px checks. Playwright 42068852661 passed 32 checks: filtered by topic, searched inside it, cleared the filters, saw the empty state, changed a vote both ways without the count drifting, renamed a topic and restored version 1, filed an article under another topic and put it back, and reordered topics with the sidebar following. The Journal slice adds cms_entries.coverImageUrl with per-language alt text and a tags TEXT[] column with a GIN index; a cover is a Cloudinary public id, an https address or a site path resolved by coverImageSrc(value, width), uploads go straight to Cloudinary when the NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_* variables exist and otherwise the field takes a pasted address. Journal bodies are edited in Tiptap and cleaned with sanitize-html on save and on render while Help and page bodies stay plain text, tags are lowercased and capped at six, and /journal filters by ?tag= against the GIN index with covers, tag links and an empty state; covers and tags travel inside each cms_versions snapshot. Closing check (49e2399): Playwright 42171733613 passed 37 checks, including every R5 CMS entity (hub, sections, settings, Help, Journal, and the public home, help, journal and policies pages) fitting 375, 768 and 1440 px.

evidence: Full Playwright run on the deployment, 150/150 at 375, 768 and 1440 px: https://github.com/ibrahimSumon47/sawdagar-dokanpart/actions/runs/42218979113 (commit 5266865). Global install verified in docs/TOOLING.md on 2026-11-06: 12 repos cloned to ~/.agents/skill-install-staging (install report in ~/.agents/skill-library/INSTALL-REPORT.md); 94 active skills in ~/.agents/skills including claude-seo, replica-skill, diagram-design, youtube-agent-skill and 14 cybersecurity skills; `node skill-library.mjs validate` passes; `npx skills list -g` lists the global skills; rea 6.8.0, agentmemory 0.9.31 and openviking 0.5.2.1 respond.
